claim_a_source_sentence: SYNTHETIC worked example: SYN:Ta100 is claimed to show 0.4054 V overpotential.
claim_b_source_sentence: SYNTHETIC worked example: SYN:Ni10Ta90 is claimed to show 0.3773 V overpotential.

experiment_design.control_conditions: same electrolyte, current density, temperature, and iR-correction as both claims
experiment_design.hypothesis: SYN:Ta100 and SYN:Ni10Ta90 differ in overpotential_at_current_density under the shared conditions.
experiment_design.instrument_source: lab-gate OERSIM (cp chronopotentiometry); replays recorded data
experiment_design.predicted_outcome_if_match_fails: the two values differ beyond the floor; the disagreement is real
experiment_design.predicted_outcome_if_match_holds: the two values agree within the floor; the disagreement dissolves
experiment_design.protocol_sketch: Measure overpotential_at_current_density for both catalysts at the shared current density and electrolyte, compare the difference against the 0.013 floor.

falsification: If the measured overpotential_at_current_density values agree within the floor, the disagreement is not real.
structural_bridge: Both claims are overpotential_at_current_density values under comparable conditions; they disagree by 0.0281.
title: Discriminate overpotential_at_current_density: SYN:Ta100 vs SYN:Ni10Ta90
value_to_lab: resolves a published disagreement before spending the lab on it
who_could_run_this: an acidic-OER electrochemistry lab (RDE or SFC)
